review: I like the look: glowing ghost, a new colour for each stage, hazards easy to see. But I got stuck too much. In First Steps my run stood in front of two spike clusters for 45 seconds, and in Spike Garden even the expert found no way forward. That is not fun in a five-minute break. Saw Mill kills beginners at 11% and Laser Gate killed me after two seconds, before I understood the blink timing. Crumble Bridge felt right, tense but fair. Spring Loaded is pretty but nobody died, so it has no thrill. Gauntlet is a wall of red at the laser and spikes.
best: Crumble Bridge is clear, tense and fair, and most players finish it.
worst: Spike Garden leaves even the high-skill player stuck with no way forward.
